description.value: Mitchie Matcha is a Vancouver cafe specializing in ceremonial-grade matcha sourced directly from three distinct regions in Japan — Shizuoka, Kagoshima, and Yame — each yielding a different flavour profile from mild and grassy to bold and umami-rich. Located on the Main Street corridor, the cafe also sells retail matcha powder online and can be hired as a drink vendor for private events ranging from small family celebrations to weddings and corporate functions. Cyclists passing through the Main Street neighbourhood will find a focused, specialty-tea experience with a strong direct-trade ethos.
